route: the runner calls acquireProductionBrandEvidence(extractionInput), which calls extractLabelEvidenceDetailed itself exactly once and returns a sealed byte package; the runner then passes that whole package to writeSealedEvidencePackage, exactly once

prohibitedRoute.why: runCaseArtifacts accepts an EvalCase, uses evalCase.caseId as artifactRef, loads the evaluation fixture, and ALWAYS constructs a truth-bearing CaseReport from Brand and Alcohol acceptable values and classifications. Discarding that report afterwards does not make the invocation truth-free: the truth was read, and the historical case id was used as the artifact reference.
prohibitedRoute.correctionOf: Amendment 1 and the original plan both routed acquisition through runCaseArtifacts. That was wrong and is corrected here, before any acquisition OCR.

requiredInvocationSteps: read the staged image by opaque filename from the mounted staged directory
verify byte length and SHA-256 against truth-free-input-manifest.json
set derivativeSha256 from the truth-free manifest
use the frozen adapter, engine and parser identities from incumbent-configuration-freeze.json
use the fixed preregistered processedAt value
await acquireProductionBrandEvidence(extractionInput), exactly once, in the runner entrypoint, then write the complete sealed package

extractionInputBinding.artifactRef: opaqueItemId — never a historical case id
extractionInputBinding.processedAtNote: The incumbent evaluation path's own EVAL_PROCESSED_AT constant. Amendment 2 stated an invented value; corrected here to the repository's own.
extractionInputBinding.ocrEngine: { kind: ocr, engineId: tesseract.js, engineVersion: 7.0.0, modelId: eng } (incumbent-configuration-freeze.json#extractionInputIdentities)

futureScriptImportProhibition.appliesTo: every acquisition-route script added in Stage 2
futureScriptImportProhibition.enforcedBy: src/fixtures/eval/issue-149-acquisition-isolation.test.ts, which fails if any acquisition-route script imports a prohibited module or references a prohibited symbol
futureScriptImportProhibition.note: Neither file exists yet. The test asserts the prohibition against whichever of them exists, so the rule binds the moment Stage 2 adds one.
futureScriptImportProhibition.transitiveClosureOwnedBy: phase 1 trusted host preparation; see acquisition-runtime-isolation-contract.json#runtimeBundle.dependencyClosureGate. The Stage 1 test is first-order source inspection only and is explicitly not a transitive proof.

haltCodes.STAGED_IMAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: staged bytes or SHA-256 disagree with the truth-free manifest
haltCodes.PROHIBITED_ACQUISITION_IMPORT: an acquisition-route script imports the evaluation harness or a governed truth module

identitiesFrozenNote: Every ExtractionInput identity now has an exact value in incumbent-configuration-freeze.json. Stage 2 reads them; it does not invent or rediscover any of them.

canonicalHelperImport.why: The runner must use the frozen reference implementation of canonicalization, the complete-record schema and the fingerprints rather than reimplementing them, because a second implementation could drift.
canonicalHelperImport.priorContradiction: Amendment 3 required the runner to use the helper while it lived at src/fixtures/eval/issue-149-candidate-canonical.ts, which the same contract and the implemented guard both prohibited importing. The helper is moved rather than the prohibition weakened.
canonicalHelperImport.canonicalizationVersionUnchanged: issue-149-candidate-canonical-v1 names the frozen algorithm, not the file path, so the version string is deliberately not renamed by the move

mandatoryProductionDependencyException.why: field-selection.ts imports it directly; the frozen route cannot run without it. Every other module under src/domain/rules/** remains prohibited.

referenceCandidateAdapter.why: The Stage 2 runner must obtain Brand evidence through this one call rather than reimplementing any part of it. A second mapping could drift from production's shape without any test noticing — which is exactly how a six-key ocrConfidence schema survived Amendment 5.
referenceCandidateAdapter.rankedMembershipRule: final ranked membership is the set of candidates carrying a decision, ordered by production's exported compareCandidateRanking with the original array order as the stable tie-break; derived internally from the selection the adapter created
referenceCandidateAdapter.comparatorWrapper: compareCandidateRanking reads only candidate.ranking, verified against the function body at the frozen base and asserted by the compatibility test, so a minimal { ranking } wrapper is faithful
referenceCandidateAdapter.usingTheModuleIsNotSufficient: Naming the adapter module is not enough: the runner must call acquireProductionBrandEvidence and nothing else in it. Every other route — a per-candidate loop, a caller-supplied selection or debug object, a direct extractor or selector call — bypasses the derivation the API owns.

keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.relation: (any candidate is kept) === (at least one candidate carries a decision)
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.why: Production always builds a non-empty ranked list and assigns exactly one selected decision whenever kept candidates exist. A kept candidate may individually lack a decision only because family reduction or deduplication removed it — which requires that another kept candidate survived.
whenAtLeastOneKeptCandidate: at least one decision-bearing final ranked member
ranked positions are unique and contiguous
every ranked member carries score and ranking semantics
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.priorGap: The array adapter derived membership from candidates carrying a decision and checked selection only when that set was non-empty. If every kept candidate's decision disappeared, the ranked set was empty and every record still passed.
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.enforcedIn: the internal array-invariant check reached through acquireProductionBrandEvidence
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.reachedPastParityBy: src/fixtures/eval/issue-149-ranked-invariants.test.ts, which controls the internally derived selection so parity succeeds and the invariant is actually evaluated

routeNote: The route is unchanged in substance: one direct extractor invocation per item, never runCaseArtifacts. What changed is who makes it and what comes back. The runner constructs the ExtractionInput, receives a sealed byte package, and passes the whole package to the authenticated writer. It never calls the extractor and never holds an evidence object.

onExtractorFailure.runnerPersists: the preregistered item-level typed failure record: ExtractionError code, message and issues, plus the manifest-sourced opaque item id and source-image SHA-256

requiredInvocationStepsNote: The final step previously read 'call extractLabelEvidenceDetailed directly', which contradicted the candidate-emission closure gate: extractLabelEvidenceDetailed is prohibited outside the adapter module. The runner's one call is acquireProductionBrandEvidence; the direct extractor call happens inside it.

extractionInputImmutability.mechanism: captureOwnDataValues validates and captures the input's exact own DATA-property values SYNCHRONOUSLY, before the first await, and the snapshot is built entirely from those captured values.

exactOwnKeyValidation.why: Object.keys returns only ENUMERABLE STRING keys, so a non-enumerable own property and a symbol-keyed own property both passed the previous closed-key-set check while being present on the object.

proxyRejected.why: A Proxy over a plain target satisfies every structural test and can present ordinary data descriptors, then return a different value from a get trap on each read. Descriptor inspection cannot see that.

whatIsFrozen.imageBytes: a PRIVATE COPIED Uint8Array with no caller-held alias. NOT frozen: a nonempty typed array cannot be frozen in current JavaScript runtimes, because its indexed elements are non-configurable and cannot be made non-writable. Isolation, not immutability, is what protects those bytes.
whatIsFrozen.priorClaim: Amendment 12 described the snapshot as 'closed and deeply frozen'. The closure is real; the deep freezing was not, and is corrected rather than restated.

extractionInputImmutability.identityIsNotPreserved: the extractor receives an object that is NOT the caller's; a test asserting toBe(input) would be asserting the defect

permittedImportsNote: Applies to the acquisition source closure as a whole. The RUNNER entrypoint's only route to evidence is scripts/eval/lib/issue-149-candidate-adapter; the extractor and field-selection imports are permitted to the adapter module only.

acquisitionApi.firstArgument: the caller's ExtractionInput. NOT ExtractionDebug, NOT a FieldSelection, NOT a candidate array.
acquisitionApi.returns: a frozen SealedItemEvidence: { itemId, outcome, files: readonly SealedEvidenceFile[], fileCount, totalBytes, aggregateSha256, failure? }
acquisitionApi.onExtractorFailure: the typed ExtractionError is NOT returned to the caller. It is sealed into <itemId>.failure.json alongside <itemId>.provenance.json, and summarised on the package as a frozen { code, message, issues }. No partial debug is synthesised and the item is never retried.
acquisitionApi.supersededReturnShape: Result<ProductionBrandEvidenceSuccess, ExtractionError> carrying detailed, diagnosticSelection and candidateRecords. Removed in Amendment 13: it left the runner holding live evidence objects, and a projection of them needs no mutation.
acquisitionApi.theRunnerPersistsBy: passing the COMPLETE sealed package to writeSealedEvidencePackage, exactly once
acquisitionApi.opaqueIdentitySource: input.artifactRef — there is no second identifier that could disagree with it
internalSteps: reject a Proxy input BEFORE any structural inspection, then capture the exact own data-property values once
validate the closed nine-key input set and four-key ocrEngine set with Reflect.ownKeys
validate input.artifactRef matches ^item-\\d{4}$, before any extractor invocation
copy imageBytes into a private Uint8Array and recompute its SHA-256
halt with EXTRACTION_INPUT_IMAGE_DIGEST_MISMATCH when that digest differs from derivativeSha256, before the extractor is invoked
build the provenance record from the private snapshot and the recomputed digest
on failure, seal the provenance record and the governed failure record and return
reconstruct the exact Brand pass set: primary OBSERVED ? [debug.passes[0]] : debug.passes
perform full-object parity internally against debug.finalSelections.brand
finalize the complete internally derived candidate population
serialize every record in production's own order and seal the complete file set
acquisitionApi.runtimeExportSurfaceVerifiedBy: dynamically importing the real module and asserting the exact sorted Object.keys of its namespace. The shell assertions in assert-adapter-surface.sh check the adapter's SOURCE surface and are useful, but they do not prove the runtime namespace and are not described as doing so.

haltCodes.MALFORMED_EXTRACTION_INPUT: an unexpected, missing, symbol-keyed, accessor-backed or wrongly typed own property, or a Proxy; raised before the extractor is invoked
haltCodes.MALFORMED_ARTIFACT_REF: input.artifactRef does not match ^item-\\d{4}$; raised before the extractor is invoked
haltCodes.EXTRACTION_INPUT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: a frozen incumbent identity differs from incumbent-configuration-freeze.json
haltCodes.EXTRACTION_INPUT_IMAGE_DIGEST_MISMATCH: the SHA-256 of the private imageBytes copy differs from derivativeSha256; raised before the extractor is invoked
haltCodes.DEBUG_PASSES_ABSENT: the extractor's debug carries no ordered pass array
haltCodes.BRAND_DIAGNOSTIC_SELECTION_PARITY_FAILUR: the internally derived selection differs from debug.finalSelections.brand once only the two complete-diagnostics fields are removed
haltCodes.COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT: the internally derived selection carries no brandDiagnostics.candidates array
haltCodes.CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED: the emitted record count does not equal the internally derived diagnostic candidate count
haltCodes.RANKED_MEMBERSHIP_INCONSISTENT: decision, ranking and rankedPosition are mutually inconsistent, or a kept population retains no ranked survivor
haltCodes.RANKED_POSITION_PARITY_FAILURE: ranked positions are not unique or contiguous, or there is not exactly one selected candidate
haltCodes.SEALED_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: the sealer's produced file set does not match the required ordered set for the outcome
haltCodes.SEALED_PACKAGE_UNAUTHENTIC: the writer received a package this module did not produce
haltCodes.SEALED_PACKAGE_INVALID: a revalidated package or descriptor invariant failed; nothing is written
haltCodes.SEALED_EVIDENCE_WRITE_UNVERIFIED: a written file did not read back with its recorded length and digest

authenticity.mechanism: a module-private WeakSet of packages produced by the sealer, plus a module-private WeakSet of descriptors produced by sealFile. A package is registered only after every internal invariant has succeeded.
authenticity.priorDefect: The writer accepted any structurally compatible object and checked only fileCount === files.length, so a caller could rewrite files, fileCount, totalBytes and aggregateSha256 together and have the subset written and the caller's own aggregate returned. A coherent forgery is still a forgery.

revalidatedBeforeAnyWrite: outcome is exactly extracted or extraction-failed
the exact outcome-specific ordered suffix set
each path is a bare governed evidence filename: no slash, backslash, NUL, absolute path, dot component or traversal
fileCount equals both files.length and the required count
every descriptor was produced by the sealer and is frozen
every bytes read has the recorded byte length and SHA-256
aggregateSha256 recomputes from the ordered path, byteLength and sha256 entries
the resolved target stays inside the resolved output directory
